title: Calibration checkpoint replay smokehouse for FP8/INT8 accuracy gating
creator: Aisha Banerjee
description:
Build a lightweight automated validation harness ("smokehouse") to replay calibration checkpoints for FP8 and INT8 profile candidates and produce deterministic accuracy signals used in gating. Goals: 1) enable fast per-checkpoint replay to surface regressions in downstream prompt-level metrics within 30 minutes of a calibration run completing; 2) provide pass/fail gates that combine token-level distance metrics, task-specific metrics, and contextual ranking comparisons; 3) integrate with CI, rollout automation, and the Console quality dashboard.

Scope and deliverables:
- A runner that can replay model checkpoints with saved calibration artifacts (per-layer scaling, bias corrections, quantization tables, and profile metadata) against a curated contrast set of ~2k golden prompts covering summarization, instruction-following, multi-turn chat, and code generation. The runner will snapshot KV cache and prefix states to ensure parity with live serving conditions.
- Metric suite: token-level KL/JS divergence, normalized log-prob difference, top-k token overlap (k=1,5,10), BLEU/ROUGE where appropriate, embed-similarity drift (cosine) with baseline, and ranking-aware pass rate for correctness probes. Each metric must expose a confidence interval via bootstrap sampling.
- Pass/fail gate logic: composite scoring that weights metrics by task type and deploy context (hosted vs dedicated vs private). Default gate = (embed-drift < 0.06 AND mean log-prob delta < 0.12 AND ranking-pass-rate >= 92%). Gates are configurable per-release.
- Stochastic perturbation mode: add small input/noise perturbations to evaluate stability under sampling and batching variance; report temporal stability and variance percentiles.
- Integration: GitHub PR check that runs the smokehouse for a high-level composite (fast mode, 100 prompts) and a nightly full run (2k prompts). Results post to Console quality dashboard and Slack channel #quant-qc.
- Artifacts: replay logs, per-prompt diffs, per-layer calibration sensitivity map, failing prompt samples with human triage tags, and a summarized CSV compatible with the Experimentation pipeline.

Acceptance criteria:
- Fast mode must finish within 30 minutes on our staging Dedicated pool for a 100-prompt set using INT8 profile; full nightly run must complete within 6 hours for FP8 profiles.
- Gate logic must produce a deterministic PASS/FAIL label and a stable composite score; less than 2% flakiness across 5 repeated runs on the same checkpoint.
- CI integration: PRs that change calibration logic must surface a green/red badge within PR checks; failing gates must block merge to main for runtime calibration releases.

Implementation notes and trade-offs:
- We will prioritize replay determinism over absolute speed in the first iteration by pinning RNG seeds, forcing single-sample determinism for beam/greedy paths, and capturing KV-cache seeds from the calibration job. This increases runner complexity but reduces false positives.
- To keep resource cost reasonable, full corpus runs will be scheduled to run on dedicated nighttime windows; daytime PR checks use a small curated subset.
- We will start with model-agnostic metrics and later add architecture-specific per-layer sensitivity heuristics.

comments: 2025-02-11: Prototype runner implemented that consumes calibration artifact tarballs from s3://calibration-artifacts/ and replays 100 golden prompts with KV snapshotting. Initial logs match baseline within expected jitter.
2025-02-18: Decided to add bootstrap confidence intervals for each metric after discussion with Applied ML; rationale: single-point thresholds caused noisy failures during early experiments.

2025-02-22: UX review (PM + Console team) requested a compact per-release summary card showing composite score, top 5 failing prompts, and per-task breakdown. Added to scope as 'dashboard-summary' artifact.

2025-02-26: Review feedback from Security: runner must not leak customer prompt text in public dashboards; implement token-level redaction policy and hashing for public summaries. Assigned follow-up task ENG-125512.
2025-03-03: Performance tuning: switched I/O stage to async s3 streaming and reduced average runtime for 100-prompt fast mode from 22m to 14m on staging Dedicated pool.
2025-03-04: Integration PR opened for CI badge: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1912. Requesting review from @eva-martin and @tony-hsu before enabling gate in runtime-1.22 branch.
